en.title: Why Do Stars Twinkle More Than Planets? | So That's Why
en.description:
From the ground, starlight passes through changing air, and refractive disturbances cause familiar twinkling. Stars are approximately point sources; a planet's larger angular disk lets fluctuations across multiple parts of its light partly average out under typical conditions. This is not immunity: strong turbulence or a position near the horizon can make planets twinkle too. Twinkling alone is not reliable instant identification. Diagrams are not to scale; no observations, angular measurements or identification tests were performed.

從地面看，光要穿過變動的大氣。不同密度的空氣使光折射，空氣團移動，送進眼睛的光跟著變動。遠方恆星近似點光源；行星肉眼也像亮點，但光盤具有較大視角，多處光線的擾動通常能部分平均。
平均不是免疫。接近地平線時光穿過更長的大氣路徑，或大氣擾動很強時，行星也可能閃爍。因此刪掉一眼分辨：閃不閃只能作線索，不能單獨確定身分。視角大小不是天體真正直徑，光盤放大只作示意。
六章480秒是企劃，非完整長片逐字稿。兩Short回答誰在變與行星也能閃。無角秒值、今晚位置、太空人硬保證，未觀測、量測、辨星或媒體生成。

en.title: What Makes a Star Appear to Twinkle?
en.description:
Familiar ground-based twinkling mainly comes from atmospheric refractive disturbances; it is not direct evidence that the star itself brightens and dims every second. Stars are approximately point sources, while fluctuations across a planet's disk usually partly average out. Strong turbulence or proximity to the horizon can make planets twinkle too. This is only a clue; no observation or identification tests were performed.

en.title: Must a Twinkling Light Be a Star?
en.description:
Planets often look steadier because atmospheric fluctuations across different parts of their angular disks can partly average out. Near the horizon, light crosses a longer atmospheric path; strong disturbances can also make planets twinkle. Twinkling or steadiness alone cannot establish identity. Angular size differs from physical size. No observation or identification tests were performed.

en.title: Why Is London Taxi Knowledge More Than 320 Routes? | So That's Why
en.description:
This episode uses All London learning as its example; the 320 runs and quarter-mile endpoint areas are not applied to all Suburban licences. TfL explains that London taxi drivers must know the relevant area. The Blue Book lists 320 runs within a six-mile radius of Charing Cross, plus roads and landmarks within a quarter-mile radius of each start and end point. One-to-one oral appearances ask about the shortest route between two points. The 320 runs are not a street count or the entire learning requirement, and six miles is not the full operating boundary. All London and Suburban licences have different areas. A moped or scooter is an option considered by some candidates. We interpret the source as combining a route list with route understanding; no ride-along, brain study or navigation comparison was done. en.title: 320 Runs Are Not the Whole London Taxi Knowledge | So That's Why
en.description:
This episode uses All London learning as its example; the 320 runs and quarter-mile endpoint areas are not applied to all Suburban licences. The Blue Book lists 320 runs, plus roads and landmarks within a quarter-mile radius of each start and end point; oral appearances ask about the shortest route between two points. The 320 runs are not a street count, the entire learning content or a fixed 320-question bank. The six-mile area is centred on Charing Cross; the smaller areas are centred on the route endpoints. This covers TfL London taxi Knowledge, not all passenger services. Concept visuals are not official examination maps. Checked 2026-10-01. Source:
https://tfl.gov.uk/info-for/taxis-and-private-hire/licensing/learn-the-knowledge-of-london

shorts.spoken: 倫敦計程車的知識考核，是背完三百二十條路線就好嗎？本集以全倫敦牌照為例。沒有這麼簡單。交通主管機關的藍皮書，列出以查令十字為中心、半徑六英里內的三百二十條路線。還要學每條路線起點和終點，各自四分之一英里半徑內的道路與地標。大範圍的中心，和兩端的小圈中心，別混在一起。口試還會問兩點間的最短路線。所以三百二十是路線清單的數量，不是街道總數，也不是全部學習內容。這套數字不套給所有郊區牌照。計程車在街上被招手，乘客才提出目的地；考核要看的，不只是能不能念出清單。

en.title: Why Eject a USB Drive Before Unplugging It? | So That's Why
en.description:
Under Windows' Better performance policy, writes to external storage may be cached. Microsoft requires Safely Remove Hardware to finish cached operations and warns of data loss if its instructions are not followed. Quick removal became the default in Windows10 version1809; Windows cannot cache disk writes under that policy, and Microsoft permits removal without that process. This does not guarantee completion of an ongoing transfer or establish that all apps and devices have no buffers or the same settings. On Mac, follow Apple's eject guidance; an app or user may still be using files if ejection fails. No unplugging, file-integrity or live UI tests were performed. No policy changes or forced-unmount instructions; original concept visuals are planned. Checked 2026-10-01.
Sources:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/client-tools/change-default-removal-policy-external-storage-media

ko.title: USB 저장 장치를 빼기 전에 왜 안전하게 제거할까?｜그래서그랬구나 사무소
ko.description:

Windows10 version1809부터 기본인 Quick removal에서는 Windows가 디스크 쓰기를 캐시하지 않으며 해당 절차 없이 제거할 수 있다고 합니다. 하지만 진행 중인 전송을 끊어도 완료된다는 보장이나 모든 앱·기기에 버퍼가 없고 설정도 같다는 뜻은 아닙니다. Mac은 Apple의 추출 안내를 따르며 추출 실패 시 앱이나 사용자가 파일을 쓰고 있을 수 있습니다. 분리·파일 무결성·실기 UI 테스트는 하지 않았습니다. 정책 변경이나 강제 마운트 해제 방법은 제공하지 않으며 직접 제작할 개념도를 계획합니다. 확인2026-10-01.
